title: rusolve.tune/1
description: Output of `rusolve tune <dir|list> --format json`. One object on stdout, progress on stderr. `profile` is a complete rusolve.profile/1 object whose `evidence` holds the held-out comparison, the race (Friedman/Conover test, eliminations, work spent, one entry per racing round in `race.rounds`), every candidate with its state and the round it first appeared in (`evidence.winner_round` names the winner's), and every wrong answer, and `train_instances` (per training instance: the static classify features and the mean cost of every candidate on it, the material an agent proposes `--candidates` from). `rusolve tune --space` prints the searched options as rusolve.tune-space/1. `verdict` is one of baseline_kept, tuned_beats_baseline_on_holdout, holdout_not_confirmed, unconfirmed_no_holdout, rejected_wrong_answer_on_holdout; the profile carries the tuned options only for tuned_beats_baseline_on_holdout.

iterations.description: Racing rounds actually run (irace iterations): 1 for the single race, at most --iterations; fewer when the budget, the blocks or the neighbourhood ran out first.

cost_metric.description: What a run's cost counts: c1_work is stats.work of rusolve.result/1 (deterministic, only attributable when solves do not overlap, so --jobs 1); iters_nodes is lp_iterations + 10 * nodes, used with --jobs > 1 because the work counters are process-wide atomics.
